title: Sub-Account Disconnection Request While Positions Are Open
precondition: Sub-account has 2 open child orders placed by manager.
steps: 1. Investor requests immediate disconnection.2. System prompts choice: 'Close open positions at market' vs 'Transfer positions to client'.
expected_result: If market close selected: child orders closed immediately, LPOA revoked, net cash returned to client control.
actual_result: Per BlackTrader API docs, POST /v1/oms/{instance}/mam/unfollow sets status to 'ended'; open child positions remain intact until squared off.

evidence.documentation: Sets the active relationship with this master to 'ended'. Profit shares taken per closed trade.
